notes.title: INDIE CUP EUROPE '24
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that two of our upcoming titles, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2916290/Pneumatic_Panic/]Pneumatic Panic[/url] as well as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2657270/Gamma_Strain/]Gamma Strain[/url] have been nominated for the Indie Cup Europe ’24. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055690/9aa7dbbf3e19ef921f4080dfbfee535c725ab078.png[/img]

[url=https://indiecup.net/]Indie Cup Europe’24[/url] is an online-only festival of upcoming indie games made in Europe. Participating developers can showcase their projects to potential partners, win awards, and get feedback from the festival jury. We are humbled and honored that they have given us this opportunity! More information about the Indie Cup can be found on the [url=https://indiecup.net/]official website[/url].

Back in 2022, our title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1291860/Rough_Justice_84/]Rough Justice: ’84[/url] was nominated and received the Indie Cup Unreal Engine Spotlight Award.

notes.title: DEV BLOG 1
notes.content:
Welcome to the first development blog for [b]Pneumatic Panic[/b]!

We here at Gamma Minus are very excited about this title. After having completed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1291860/Rough_Justice_84/]Rough Justice: '84[/url], we're thrilled to move on, and embark on a new journey.  But what IS Pneumatic Panic?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055690/1679a62a22e9401bca9783ede21349d05dfb6f07.png[/img]

Pneumatic Panic is a chaotic co-op road trip game for one to four players. Working as a team, you and your fellow companions must arrive at the campgrounds with your supplies, avoiding obstacles along the way.

You'll have to coordinate your efforts by completing contextual events, for example, avoiding logs and wildlife, foraging for fruit, close doors to prevent the loss of luggage, and pumping up deflated tires. 

The vehicle is constantly moving forward and players take turns swerving to avoid obstacles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055690/a3642aed84a1ba6369d61e51064dcbf66b0fa674.png[/img]

Currently, we have a 1, 2, and 4-player mode in the works. We maaaaaaaaaaaay end up having a 3-player mode, but no promises! 

[h2]SINGLE-PLAYER MODE[/h2]
In the single-player mode, you'll be responsible for the following:
- Swerving
- Picking up fruit
- Avoiding obstacles
- Avoiding wildlife
- Pumping up flat tires
- Closing doors
- Refilling the radiator

[h2]TWO-PLAYER MODE[/h2]
The roles are set.
[b]Player 1: [/b]
- Swerve
- Avoid obstacles
- Avoid wildlife
- Honk to startle wildlife
- Pump up front tires

[b]Player 2:[/b]
- Pick up fruit
- Close doors
- Refill the radiator
- Pump up back tires
- Pick up fallen luggage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055690/96cd77b87b5d6649d69ffcaa173b358b7d71f787.gif[/img]

[h2]FOUR-PLAYER MODE[/h2]
The 4-player mode introduces role rotation.

[b]Player One[/b] is in charge of driving for the next 30 seconds.
[b]Player Two[/b] can pick fruit on the left-hand side
[b]Player Three[/b] can pick fruit on the right-hand side
[b]Player Four [/b]can honk the horn and fill up the radiator 

All players are responsible for fixing their respective punctured tires.

Player One = Front Left tire
Player Two = Front Right Tire
Player Three = Back left tire
Player Four = Back right tire

[b]Rotating Roles[/b]
- Driver
- Left Picker
- Right Picker
- Security & Maintenance

We hope that this gives you a bit of a rough overview of what our plans are for Pneumatic Panic! Stay tuned for future dev blogs. If you have any feedback, feel free to leave a comment below!
